legislation.bill: S2368 / A4836 (Garden State Balcony Solar Act)
legislation.notes: Passed both chambers unanimously 30 June 2026 (Senate 40-0, Assembly 79-0-1). Still awaiting Governor Sherrill as at 1 August 2026: the Governor's own bill-action releases of 30 June and 7 July 2026 do not include it. The enacted short title in the bill text is "Garden State Balcony Solar Act" - trade coverage widely calls it the "Plug-In Solar Act", which is not the statutory name. Takes effect six months after the date of enactment.
